upstreams.name: tianyehedashu/ziniao-mcp
upstreams.watch: CLI commands, optional MCP server, site presets, RPA flows, skill installer ideas
upstreams.adoption_policy: Track manually through GitHub/PyPI because unauthenticated git ls-remote currently returns repository not found; keep default ziniao-ops install independent from this dependency.

upstreams.name: PyPI ziniao
upstreams.watch: Published package version and install command changes
upstreams.adoption_policy: Use as package reference only; do not make it a default employee dependency.

upstreams.name: zpoint/vibe-seller
upstreams.watch: Local-first seller automation, store isolation, CDP/browser control, task reporting
upstreams.adoption_policy: Borrow concepts; do not turn ziniao-ops into a long-running web service by default.

upstreams.name: WW-AI-Lab/auto-ziniao
upstreams.watch: ZClaw bridge boundary, flow validation, WebAdmin concepts, self-heal records
upstreams.adoption_policy: Reference architecture only unless permission is granted; do not copy code into this public repo.

upstreams.name: BrowserMCP/mcp
upstreams.watch: Existing-profile browser control, local privacy model, MCP browser control patterns
upstreams.adoption_policy: Use for future optional generic browser/MCP integration notes only.

upstreams.name: ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp
upstreams.watch: Official Chrome DevTools MCP, --browser-url, --autoConnect, debugging/performance inspection
upstreams.adoption_policy: Use as the primary reference for connecting to already-running Chrome/Edge CDP endpoints; keep sensitive-page warnings and opt-in external MCP setup.

upstreams.name: microsoft/playwright-mcp
upstreams.watch: Accessibility snapshots, deterministic actions, --cdp-endpoint support, Codex MCP setup examples
upstreams.adoption_policy: Borrow design ideas for structured page snapshots and existing CDP connection options; do not make Playwright a required dependency for the lightweight skill.

upstreams.name: Rainmen-xia/chrome-debug-mcp
upstreams.watch: Persistent logged-in Chrome sessions through remote debugging ports
upstreams.adoption_policy: Borrow existing-debug-port discovery and session-persistence ideas only after security review.

upstreams.name: echo-lumen/cdp-browser-mcp
upstreams.watch: Compact accessibility-tree snapshots and indexed page references
upstreams.adoption_policy: Borrow token-efficient snapshot/report-shape concepts; do not replace purpose-built shop/ERP scripts with a generic agent loop.

upstreams.name: Silbercue/public-browser
upstreams.watch: Direct CDP multi-tab support, stable accessibility refs, cached reference maps
upstreams.adoption_policy: Borrow multi-tab and stable-reference ideas if they stay compatible with local-only/no-secret boundaries.

upstreams.name: ComposioHQ/awesome-codex-skills
upstreams.watch: Codex skill packaging and discovery patterns
upstreams.adoption_policy: Track ecosystem patterns; do not add unrelated skills to this repo.

upstreams.name: clawdbot-ai/awesome-openclaw-skills-zh
upstreams.watch: Chinese skill wording, browser and MCP skill categories, user-facing install patterns
upstreams.adoption_policy: Manual review only because the recorded GitHub repository is not currently accessible through git ls-remote; review third-party skill security before adopting anything.

upstreams.name: Ziniao Open Platform docs
upstreams.watch: Ziniao Open Platform and assistant/ZClaw documentation changes
upstreams.adoption_policy: Prefer official docs for future ZClaw or Open Platform support.
